Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD
Critical evaluation of AI-generated information — As AI helps with research and data, the ability to check if information is correct and complete becomes very important for making good decisions.
Complex problem-solving and strategic thinking — AI can help with basic analysis, but human judgment is needed to solve difficult business problems and plan smart strategies for clients.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to ask a free AI tool to summarize recent news about a major economic trend in the GCC (for example, oil prices or a new development project). Then, research the same trend using reliable news sources and official reports. Compare the AI summary with your own research, noting any differences or details the AI missed. Think about what deeper, strategic questions you would ask a client based on your findings.
YOU WILL HAVE

You will have two documents: the AI-generated summary and your notes from independent research, along with your reflections on the AI's accuracy and completeness, and a list of strategic questions you would ask a client.
